items.title: Security Bosses Are All-In on AI. Here's Why
items.description: CISOs are bullish on AI and have big plans to roll out future tools. We talk to Reddit CISO Frederick Lee and leading analyst Dave Gruber about how AI is working out in the real world, as well as its future promise.

items.title: Critical Vulnerability in Claude Code Emerges Days After Source Leak
items.description: Within days of each other, Anthropic first leaked the source code to Claude Code, and then a critical vulnerability was found by Adversa AI. The post Critical Vulnerability in Claude Code Emerges Days After Source Leak appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: How Elite SOCs Cut Escalation Rates by Arming Tier 1 With Better Threat Intelligence

items.title: ZDI-CAN-29886: Adobe
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Brandon Evans' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-04-02, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-07-31 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
